audit.method: Every double-quoted span in a rule excerpt is compared with the archived plain-text snapshot of the official document the rule cites. Whitespace, PDF line breaks, curly quotes and thousands separators are normalised; nothing else is. A row's label is then compared with what its own document prints: a further-entry sentence cannot support a single-entry label, and a 'no such clause appears anywhere' claim is re-tested with a keyword sweep of the same snapshot.
